program.name: HIIT AMRAP Plus
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: Two no-gear AMRAPs a day, with a short rest between them.
program.about: As many rounds as you can, twice. Each day is two AMRAPs of jumps, pushes, legs and core, with a short rest between; two days alternate so the moves change. Count your rounds and beat them next time. Abs finish every session. Level II brings harder variations and Level III adds reps.
